product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig cesspools are a great option for off-mains buildings where the surrounding area means it’s not possible to install a soakaway to go hand in hand with a septic tank or sewage treatment plant. Clearwater cesspools are for use in situations where there is a high winter water table, where the area of installation is a protected zone or if the soil it will be installed in to is the wrong type to allow a drainage field to be installed.
These shallow dig cesspools have 1 inlet and a lid, which can be removed for the contents to be pumped out by a specialist operator. As a total containment tank, these shallow dig cesspools from Clearwater can be used for the storage of surface water, animal waste, as rainwater harvesting reservoirs and as firefighting reservoirs in areas where there are no mains connections. This cesspool cannot be used for the storage of drinking water.
By opting for this Clearwater shallow dig cesspool labour costs and installation time is minimised as less ground needs to be excavated. Manufactured from chemically resistant and watertight GRP, on dry sites these cesspools can be backfilled with pea shingles with no concerns over durability or stability on the cesspool.
Please note: For collecting and storing the effluence of a domestic, commercial or industrial building, the smallest capacity cesspool that must be used, to comply with building regulations, is 18000 litres.
product.variant_name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool - 2800 litres

product.name: Clearwater Alpha Spherical Onion Septic Tank with A15 Lid
product.description:
The Clearwater Alpha range of Septic Tanks only provides settlement for sewage solids. The liquid overflow requires further biological treatment in a suitably designed, correctly situated drainage field. This septic tank from Clearwater comes with an A15 load class lid.

Made from composite GRP - strong, light, chemically resistant and watertight
Press moulded shape provides wide, squat, form which makes the tank easy to install and handle
Stable base for storage
Shackles are provided to aid lifting and positioning within the excavation
All unit volumes are designed in accordance with the recommendations given in BS 6297:1983
The new manufacturing process minimises styrene emissions and reduces waste - all the better for our environment

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Septic Tank
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig septic tanks are the perfect choice for when sewage treatment plants, which discharge cleaned effluent into the ground, are not suitable. Throughout the Clearwater septic tank range, this is the highest capacity tank and it can store the effluent of up to 47 people, perfect for off-mains domestic properties, holiday homes and static caravans.
To reduce costs and installation time this septic tank is shallow dig, meaning you need to excavate less of the ground where it will be installed. Save on labour costs even more on dry sites too as this septic tank can be backfilled with pea shingles. There’s no need to worry about the durability of this septic tank with pea shingles or concrete backfill as it’s manufactured from strong, chemically resistant and watertight GRP.
99.7% efficient and approved to EN12566-1, these septic tanks are the perfect upgrade from traditional cesspools as they tend to last longer, increase hygiene and have improved efficiency in the treatment of waste.

An ideal fitting to go alongside your Prostyle plastic guttering, this Prostyle fascia bracket fastens against your fascia board to provide incredible support and unwavering assistance to your gutter runs while they collect water.

product.description:
This Prostyle running outlet firmly situates itself between two different 106mm guttering runs and provides an access point (an outlet) for water to collect and stream down towards the downpipe, and ultimately the drainage systems below.

This running outlet from the Prostyle collection is a useful addition to your guttering that has minimal risk of corrosion, leaks, and breakages. product.description:
Taking a unique and contemporary spin on a traditional style of guttering, the Cascade Prostyle range from Brett Martin features this plastic union bracket that sturdily joins together two gutter parts.
As well as uniting two pieces of guttering, this iron style union bracket provides additional support to the given joints and attachments by screwing into the fascia board where necessary. The Cascade Prostyle range parallels regular cast iron systems and can be a perfect replacement. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
This Roundstyle uPVC plastic downpipe aims to create a steady path that effortlessly directs rainwater towards the pipe shoe and to the drain. Including lugs for easy and quick attachments, this plastic downpipe fits neatly into a 68mm downpipe system that settles into a corner. 
Like its fellow Cascade products, this Roundstyle downpipe features a cast iron adjacent finish that creates a rustic and traditional feel. While this downpipe is suited to newer applications, it is also ideal for modern refurbishments on heritage buildings where cast iron products may need replacing. In this Cascade downpipe, Brett Martin provides a versatile product that successfully fulfills its purpose and that can increase efficiency in authentic cast iron systems. product.description:

Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Round downpipes, this downpipe clip is ready to fit, providing a quick and easy installation.
Perfect for complementing the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, this downpipe clip is ideal for renovation projects and period styled new builds. As part of the Roundstyle or Deepstyle Cast Iron Style Domestic Rainwater Systems, this downpipe clip is fully compatible with existing rainwater systems, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron. product.description:
This corner round plastic pipe shoe from Brett Martin is a member of their innovative Cascade range Equipped with lugs to ease wall mounting and installations where downpipes slot into corners, the fitting also embodies a cast iron style finish that particularly suits new and refurbished heritage buildings.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Small Ogee Hopper
product.description:
The Cascade corner downpipe system is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast iron systems. This system is used on the corners of properties.
The authentic styling of the round downpipe system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Pipe couplers allow for more than one downpipe to be connected in series. Cast iron connectors are sometimes decoratively branded. Plastic downpipes may, however, just join by sitting the upper pipe inside the lower, without connectors, which creates a watertight seal.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
Ideal for channelling rainwater from your roof into your drains, this uPVC downpipe is available in a range of heritage colours, lengths and diameters to choose from and fit the architectural appearance of your building. Ready to fit, this downpipe is easy to install with the Cast Iron Style Round downpipe fittings.
Perfectly suited for traditionally designed buildings, renovation projects and period styled new builds, this downpipe blends perfectly with the architectural detail of heritage buildings with authentic detailing and finish and the appearance of original Cast Iron. As an affordable, lighter alternative to traditional cast iron styling, this uPVC downpipe is durable, non-corrosive and UV resistant ensuring a reliable and secure installation with low maintenance requirements. Fully compatible with existing rainwater systems, this downpipe can be incorporated with the Roundstyle or Deepstyle Domestic Rainwater System at 68mm and with the Deepstyle High Capacity Rainwater System at 105mm.

The 105mm downpipe can be part of a higher drainage efficiency of rainwater for larger roof areas ensuring a higher capacity rainwater system, making it ideal for a variety of large heritage style buildings.

Allowing you to keep your downpipe as close to the wall as possible to ensure vertical water runs, this offset bend will reduce your debris build-up and keep your guttering system at a higher capacity for longer. Available in a range of colours, diameters and offset lengths, this Round style offset can fit your building needs.
Suited for period designed new builds, renovation projects and traditionally styled buildings, this uPVC offset is finished with authentic detailing making it synonymous with traditional cast iron styling, blending perfectly with the architectural detail on heritage buildings. Undifferentiable from original Cast Iron systems, this offset is fully compatible with traditional Cast Iron, the Cast Iron Style Soil System and existing rainwater systems and is a lighter, more affordable replacement for cast iron. Made from robust uPVC, this offset is durable, non-corrosive and fully UV stabilised. For an offset to confidently attach your guttering from the roofline to your downpipe, this Roundstyle adjustable offset is the perfect option for creating this connection and allowing the downpipe system to fix against the wall. 
This adjustable offset exists alongside the rest of the Cascade cast iron range by Brett Martin, and appropriately connects to a 68mm downpipe on modern applications that encompass an archaic building style. The finish perfectly parallels a genuine cast iron pipe, in turn making it ideal to substitute one in applications where you want a conventional design but still wish to incorporate modern-day expertise. For that much desired adjustability, this offset can be utilised in sizes from 250mm to 650mm.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Adjustable OffsetVersatile in sizing and colour for an assortment of installations and aesthetics  Durable uPVC plastic construction that won’t corrode  Withstands excellently against UV damage  Easy to handle.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Round Plastic Downpipe Clip
product.description:
These downpipe clips are part of the Roundstyle Cast Iron Style Rainwater System, synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original Cast Iron systems.
The authentic styling of the Roundstyle system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Secures a downpipe to the wall - there should be one positioned near the top of the first pipe and then around every metre after that.
Two sorts are generally available: the saddle bracket and the barrel clip.
The saddle bracket just holds the pipe away from the wall while the barrel clip gives a firmer grip to the pipe and prevents it moving up and down.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Deepstyle Plastic Gutter
product.description:
This Cascade Deepstyle plastic gutter by Brett Martin is brilliant for guttering installations where you wish for a cast iron style finish with all the perks of modern uPVC plastic systems. 
Ideal for following your roofline to catch rainfall and guide it to the running outlet and consequently the downpipe, this guttering has a Deepstyle profile to hold high capacities of water. Brett Martin manufactures their Cascade range out of UV stabilised plastic that takes on the appearance of cast iron in a whole variety of colours, giving it an authentic heritage look that remains lightweight and easy to maneuver, install, and won’t result in any unnecessary pressure on fascia brackets.Features & Benefits: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Deepstyle Plastic GutterMultiple sizing options to suit different gutter systems  No risk of corrosion  Designed for long-term use  Suited to builds that are modern or refurbished with a unique historical aesthetic  Cost-friendly option that can replace real cast iron.

This external stop end closes off a run of guttering and helps to channel the flow of rainwater into outlets and into the rainwater system below. Available in a variety of colours and diameters to match the Cast Iron Style Deepstyle guttering with your rainwater system, this stop end is ready to fit and quick and easy to install.
As an affordable, lighter alternative to cast iron, this external stopend has the authentic detailing and finish of original cast iron architectural features. Made from robust uPVC, this stopend is durable, fully UV stabilised and non-corrosive with minimal maintenance requirements. Compatible with existing rainwater systems, this stopend is ideal for higher capacity semi-elliptical rainwater systems providing greater drainage efficiency on larger roof areas with the 170mm stopend suited for very high levels of roof drainage on a variety of large heritage style buildings. As a perfect fit for the architectural features of renovation projects and traditionally designed buildings, this external stopend provides a heritage style without compromising on the integrity of your building.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Rectangular Plastic 112.5 Degree Side Spigot Offset
product.description:
This 112.5 degree bend will allow you to keep your downpipe as close to the wall as possible to ensure vertical water runs. This will reduce debris build up and keep your guttering system high capacity for longer.
Cascade Cast Iron Style Guttering
Achieve all the benefits of plastic guttering with all the traditional and period style looks of Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Manufactured from plastic, the guttering is designed to look like cast iron so it’s a match to heritage and listed properties. As the plastic cast iron style guttering isn’t as heavy as actual cast iron guttering you can be reassured that installing new guttering won’t make any damage to the property.
The high capacity 170mm deepstyle guttering can be installed on residential projects, commercial projects and traditional church or school buildings too. The gutters are designed to hold a high capacity of water so any roofs with a large surface area can benefit from Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering. Choose between ogee, bath, motiffed and gothic hoppers to complement your cast iron style guttering and to achieve the period detailing so common in cast iron materials. The authentic-looking hoppers will give an attractive finishing touch whilst remaining affordable and resistant to corrosion.
Install Cascade Cast Iron Style guttering with a 12mm slope at 3m intervals for maximum water flow towards outlets and fix the gutters in place at a minimum of 1m intervals.

product.name: Caroflow Roof Drain Threaded Adaptor
product.description: From Caroflow, this roof drain threaded adaptor is used to extend the length of outlets. With a male taper at one end compliant with BS21, this adaptor is perfect for joining into any Caroflow threaded connection outlets. From vertical threaded to two-way outlets and more. The other end is chamfered to BSEN 1566:2004 spigot dimensions and comes in a variety of sizes to ensure you find the right size for your outlet. As an extending section, this adaptor can be used whenever extra length is required. You can opt for different lengths to find the right one for your extension requirements. product.name: DEKS Flat Roof Square Horizontal Parapet Drain - Black TPE
product.description:
The DEKS Flat Roof Square Horizontal Parapet Drain is a high-quality connector designed to link flat roof drainage systems to rainwater downpipes through walls. Suitable for 90° horizontal or vertical outlet use, it is available in two cross-sections to adapt to varying water discharge requirements. The angled flange simplifies installation on roofs with a fall, ensuring a watertight fit.
Made from flexible TPE, the connector maintains its mechanical and physical properties even at low temperatures and resists deterioration from sun and ozone. The large, perforated flange ensures perfect adhesion with bituminous membranes, while the 425mm square tube allows walls up to 400mm to be crossed. Compatible with APP and SBS prefabricated bituminous membranes and coatings.Features & Benefits: DEKS Flat Roof Square Horizontal Parapet Drain - Black TPETPE construction for long-term flexibility, watertightness, and chemical resistanceLarge perforated flange for secure bonding with bituminous membranesSuitable for horizontal or vertical outlets and walls up to 400mm
product.variant_name: DEKS Flat Roof Square 65mm Horizontal Parapet Drain - Black TPE

product.name: DEKS Flat Roof Horizontal Parapet Drain Angled Pipe Connector in Brown
product.description: The DEKS Flat Roof Horizontal Parapet Drain Angled Pipe Connector is designed to efficiently divert rainwater from a horizontal square angle drain connector to a vertical downpipe. Available in cross-sections of 65mm x 100mm and 100mm x 100mm, with outlet diameters of 80mm or 100 mm, this connector ensures seamless integration with standard rainwater systems.Its sleek, linear design without grooves provides an aesthetically pleasing finish, making it suitable for high-quality buildings. Four internal wings securely attach the connector to the drain, preventing warping over time, while the dark brown colour blends neatly with commercially available rainwater pipes. Resistant to sun, ozone, atmospheric chemicals, and extreme temperatures, the connector maintains its flexibility and mechanical properties for long-term durability.Features & Benefits: DEKS Flat Roof Horizontal Parapet Drain Angled Pipe Connector in BrownDiverts rainwater efficiently from horizontal drains to vertical downpipesSleek, groove-free design with internal wings to prevent deformationResistant to sun, ozone, chemicals, and maintains flexibility in low temperatures

Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Internal Angle
product.description:
Straight forward installation and excellent aesthetics are provided by this visually compact yet highly efficient profiled gutter system. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.
Like all Brett Martin rainwater products the use of UV stabilised plastic is standard so that systems retain their high quality appearance thus giving excellent durability.
Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 114mm Squarestyle Gutter
product.description:
The shape of the 114mm squarestyle rainwater system provides a very clean and simple look, ideal in structures with contemporary styling. The clean lines of the gutter and downpipe systems give a flow capacity up to 20% higher than half round systems which means not only does Squarestyle look good it performs well.
Squarestyle like Roundstyle, Deepstyle and Prostyle features integral fixing clips that allow quick and easy snap together assembly on the gutter length. Careful design ensures these are robust enough to provide years of trouble free service yet are flexible enough to allow simple installation. The outlets and unions feature external fixing wings, making them power tool friendly for simple installation.
Brett Martin’s rainwater systems have been successfully tested for accelerated ageing in accordance with BS EN 607: 1995. The manufacturer guarantees the colourfastness of white rainwater systems for a period of ten years, from date of manufacture. Full warranty detailsare available on request from Brett Martin Ltd.
Features

Modern appearance.
Easy installation.
Up to 20% higher flow capacity than half round systems.
Excellent drainage for larger domestic roofs.
Three colour options available.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

The shape of the 114mm squarestyle rainwater system provides a very clean and simple look, ideal in structures with contemporary styling. The clean lines of the gutter and downpipe systems give a flow capacity up to 20% higher than half round systems which means not only does Squarestyle look good it performs well.
Squarestyle like Roundstyle, Deepstyle and Prostyle features integral fixing clips that allow quick and easy snap together assembly on the gutter length. Careful design ensures these are robust enough to provide years of trouble free service yet are flexible enough to allow simple installation. The outlets and unions feature external fixing wings, making them power tool friendly for simple installation.
Brett Martin’s rainwater systems have been successfully tested for accelerated ageing in accordance with BS EN 607: 1995. The manufacturer guarantees the colourfastness of white rainwater systems for a period of ten years, from date of manufacture. Full warranty detailsare available on request from Brett Martin Ltd.
Features

Modern appearance.
Easy installation.
Up to 20% higher flow capacity than half round systems.
Excellent drainage for larger domestic roofs.
Three colour options available.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 114mm Squarestyle Gutter Angle
product.description:
The shape of the 114mm squarestyle rainwater system provides a very clean and simple look, ideal in structures with contemporary styling. The clean lines of the gutter and downpipe systems give a flow capacity up to 20% higher than half round systems which means not only does Squarestyle look good it performs well.
Squarestyle like Roundstyle, Deepstyle and Prostyle features integral fixing clips that allow quick and easy snap together assembly on the gutter length. Careful design ensures these are robust enough to provide years of trouble free service yet are flexible enough to allow simple installation. The outlets and unions feature external fixing wings, making them power tool friendly for simple installation.
Brett Martin’s rainwater systems have been successfully tested for accelerated ageing in accordance with BS EN 607: 1995. Modern appearance.
Easy installation.

Excellent drainage for larger domestic roofs.
Three colour options available.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

This Brett Martin Square downpipe shoe is ideal for fixing at the bottom of Square downpipes. It directs the rainwater towards the floor level drainage and comes particularly in handy for downpipes that may be positioned slightly away from the drain. You can choose from a fantastic array of colour options to suit your rainwater systems and buildings, in turn making it a versatile product that caters to your needs and preferences.

These 'Deepstyle' industrial gutter sections from Brett Martin are part of a high-capacity drainage system that offers serious flow rates for serious projects, from farm buildings and apartment blocks to factories and warehouses. product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Gutter Fabricated Angle
product.description:
Straight forward installation and excellent aestherics are provided by this visually compact yet highly efficient profiled gutter system. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.
Like all Brett Martin rainwater products the use of UV stabilised plastic is standard so that systems retain their high quality appearance thus giving excellent durability.
Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

Please note that this is a made to order product. During checkout please specify the angle required or get in touch with a member of the team.
